name: smwmusic-new-home-with-friends
title: New Home with Friends
description:
The ending theme from a Cave Story mod I made back in 2019.
Do note that this song doesn't loop, so it's usage end up being very limited.
Also, due to myself end up using the large piano sample, found on KSSU's Save Hut version on this song, the unoptimized version ends up ommiting the Thunder SFX sample.
Knowing this, an optimized version of the pianos is included, in case you want to use it somewhere else. (who knows :p) If you want to use those optimized pianos version, open the text file, and change the "Optimize_Pianos" define's value, to anything other than 0.
